blocks.text: Ketones secondary alcohols ki oxidation se banaye jate hain.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Propan-2-ol mein OH wala carbon do carbon atoms se jura hai (secondary alcohol). Oxidation mein is carbon ka H aur OH ka H nikal kar paani banate hain aur C=O ban jata hai, yani propanone (ketone). Ketone aage acid mein oxidise nahi hota, is liye ise foran distil karne ki zaroorat nahi (23.1.1).

blocks.prompt: Butanone, CH₃COCH₂CH₃, banane ke liye kaun sa alcohol oxidise karenge?
blocks.explanation: Butan-2-ol, CH₃CH(OH)CH₂CH₃, jo aik secondary alcohol hai.

items: Secondary alcohol + [O] → ketone + H₂O (acidified K₂Cr₂O₇, heat).
